Once upon a time, in a land full of light, there were two friends named Tom and Sue. They liked to play outside all day. One day, they saw a big tree with a hole in it. They were curious and wanted to see what was inside. They decide to look inside the hole when it was not dark.
The next day, Tom and Sue went to the tree when the sun was up, and it was light outside. They looked inside the hole and saw something shiny. They were very excited and wanted to see what it was. But they had to wait, as their mom called them for lunch.
After lunch, Tom and Sue went back to the tree. It was getting dark, but they wanted to see the shiny thing. They reached inside the hole and pulled out a small box. They opened the box and found a beautiful, shiny stone. They were so happy they found the stone when it was still light outside. They ran home to show their mom the pretty stone they found. And from that day on, Tom and Sue always had a little bit of light, even when it was dark.

Once upon a time, there was a noisy dog named Max. Max liked to bark and play all day long. He lived in a small house with his best friend, a little girl named Lily.
One day, Lily found a note on the floor. It said, "Do not spoil the cake in the kitchen." Lily wanted to tell Max about the note, but Max was too busy playing with his toys. So, Lily went to the kitchen to see the cake.
As Lily looked at the cake, Max came running into the kitchen. He was very excited and accidentally knocked over the cake! "Oh no, Max!" said Lily, "You spoiled the cake!" Max felt sad and said, "I'm sorry, Lily."
Lily hugged Max and said, "It's okay, Max. We can make a new cake together." Max wagged his tail and barked happily. And so, Lily and Max made a new cake, and they were more careful this time. They had a fun day and learned the importance of reading notes.

Once upon a time, there was a bright meadow. It had sunshine and lots of colorful flowers.
One day, a little girl came running into the meadow. She stopped to gaze at the beauty around her. She saw a bright blue sky and a river that was wet and shining in the sun. 
She began to explore and soon found a funny looking bug. She giggled and watched it scurry away. As she forgot about the bug, she noticed the lake beyond the meadow. It was so sparkly and bright. 
The girl couldn't help but splash around in the lake. Even though her clothes got wet, she was having so much fun. She laughed and enjoyed the sun.
Soon, the little girl got tired and decided to rest on the grass. She closed her eyes and gazed up at the sky. It was so blue and bright. 
The little girl was content and happy in her bright meadow.

Once upon a time, there was a bright sun in the sky. It was very hot outside. A little girl named Lily wanted to go to the pool to swim and play. She put on her swimsuit and went to the pool with her mom.
At the pool, Lily saw her friend Tom. They were so happy to see each other. They played in the water, splashing and laughing. They remembered the last time they played at the pool together. It was so much fun.
After a while, the sun started to go down. It was time for Lily and Tom to leave the pool. They said goodbye and went home with their moms. They were tired but happy. They couldn't wait to come back to the pool and play again.

One day, a girl named Amy went to a yoga class with her mom. Amy liked yoga because it was fun and made her feel good. The room was big and had soft mats on the floor. Amy and her mom put their mats next to each other.
Amy's friend, Ben, was also at the yoga class. Ben was very noisy. He talked and laughed a lot. Amy said, "Ben, please be quiet. Yoga is a quiet time." Ben tried to be quiet, but it was hard for him.
Then, something unexpected happened. A big, friendly dog walked into the yoga room. The dog wanted to do yoga too! Everyone laughed, even the yoga teacher. The dog put his paws on the mat and did yoga with Amy, Ben, and their moms. Ben was still a little noisy, but everyone had fun with the dog. The yoga class was very special that day.

Once upon a time, there was a big chair. The chair was made of leather. The leather was not soft, it was harsh. The chair was in a small house.
One day, a little boy named Tom went to the house. Tom saw the big chair. He wanted to sit on it. He climbed up and sat on the leather chair.
At first, it felt harsh to him. But Tom did not care. He liked to sit on the big chair. Tom sat and sat until it was time to go home. He was happy he found the big chair.

Tom and Mia are friends. They like to play at the park. They like to swing, slide and run. One day, they see a new thing at the park. It is a gym. It has ropes, bars and rings. Tom and Mia want to try it.
"Look, Mia, a gym!" Tom says. "Let's go and play!"
"OK, Tom, but be careful. It looks hard," Mia says.
They run to the gym. Tom climbs on a rope. He swings like a monkey. Mia holds a bar. She spins like a star. They have fun.
But then, they hear a growl. They look down. They see a big, hairy dog. It is angry. It wants the gym for itself.
"Ruff, ruff, ruff!" the dog barks. "Go away, kids! This is my gym!"
Tom and Mia are scared. They drop from the rope and the bar. They run away from the dog. They find their moms.
"Mama, mama, there is a big, hairy dog at the gym!" Tom says. "It chased us away!"
"Oh, no, Tom, that is not nice!" his mom says. "Are you OK?"
"Mama, mama, can we go to another park?" Mia says. "I don't like that dog!"
"Of course, Mia, we can go to another park," her mom says. "Maybe there is a nicer gym there."
Tom and Mia hug their moms. They say goodbye to the park. They hope to find a better place to play.

Once upon a time, there was a fisherman named Tom. Tom loved to gather fish from the big blue sea. He would go out on his little boat every day to catch fish.
One day, Tom was feeling impatient. He wanted to catch many fish very fast. So, he went to a new spot in the sea. He threw his net into the water and waited for the fish to come.
Tom's net became very heavy. He pulled and pulled, and out came many fish! Tom was so happy. He took the fish home to share with his friends and family. From that day on, Tom knew that being patient was important when gathering fish.

Once upon a time, in a wild and big forest, there lived a little girl named Lily. She liked to play with her ball and run around the trees. One day, while she was playing, she saw a big and tall tree. She wanted to use her arm to get the ball that was stuck in the tree.
Lily tried to use her arm to reach the ball, but it was too high. She looked around and found a long stick. She used the stick to try to get the ball out of the tree. But the stick was not long enough.
Lily was very sad. She walked home without her ball. She told her mom what happened. Her mom said, "I am sorry, Lily. We cannot get the ball back. It is lost in the wild forest." Lily cried and went to bed, feeling very sad. The end.

One day, a little girl named Annabel had a very boring day. She felt like nothing was fun to do. She just sat in her room and shrugged. Nothing seemed interesting. 
Suddenly, Annabel had an idea. She decided to grab her grandpa's cane from the hallway. She waved it around and pretended it was a magical wand. She could see it could do so many things! Annabel smiled and laughed as she used it to explore different parts of her house. 
Before long, Annabel was having a much better day. She waved her cane around and smiled. Every time she used it, she found something new and exciting. Grandpa's cane truly was magical! 
The day flew by as Annabel continued to explore with her grandpa's cane. Before Annabel knew it, it was time for her to go to bed. She put the cane back in the hallway and headed to her room. What an exciting day! She was no longer bored.
